mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This meal consists of a single raw carrot, which is low in calories and has a low glycemic impact on blood sugar levels for someone with diabetes. It is a good source of fiber and vitamins. It is best to include such whole vegetables as part of a balanced diet.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A single peeled raw carrot, providing fiber, vitamins, and low glycemic carbohydrates.
